title: TURP design file (.rrdesign.json)
description: Compact, hand/Codex-writable level description. `node rr-cli.js build` turns it into the runtime level (schema v1) with the same builder the Unity Level Editor uses. World units; angles in degrees, counter-clockwise from +X. All angles are WORLD angles at the start of the level.

_notes.description: Written by `describe`: parts of the source level whose sizes differ from the defaults (rebuilt with defaults).

id.description: Your label, e.g. R1. Targets refer to it.

gapDir.description: World direction of the gap centre.

gap.description: Logic gap in degrees; 0 = closed ring.

collect.description: Challenge: the ring may carry a Fish (runtime canCollect). The game picks up to 3 marked rings per play.

angle.description: World direction from the owner's centre.

length.description: Outer pin: outer edge of the owner -> pin head centre (0.45..8, default 0.8354 = head 2.8354 from the centre of a standard ring). Inner pin: inner edge of the owner -> pin head centre, inwards (0.2 .. inner radius - 0.05).

inner.description: Inner-mounted pin: rooted on the owner's inner edge and pointing inwards into a ring/bar that lies inside the owner (runtime isInnerMount, like Unity RotateCompactLayout.ConfigureInnerPin). angle is still the world direction from the owner's centre to the head.

targets.description: Ids of the rings/sticks this pin locks. Empty = pin only blocks.

length.description: Positive: how far it sticks out beyond the ring's outer edge (min 0.2). Negative: it points INTO the ring, |length| beyond the inner edge (min 0.2, stops 0.05 before the centre).

arm.description: L: arm down (-Y) at +X end; U: both arms up (+Y).

path.description: Explicit stick-local polyline instead of shape/length/arm.

slideAxis.description: Stick-local slide direction. Needed for a bent stick that has no guide and no pin along a straight segment.

angle.description: World direction of the passage (= slide direction). Default: the stick angle.

x.description: World position at start; default = host centre.
